plugin.name: AI
plugin.description: Chat with Claude in the launcher through your Claude Code CLI and subscription.
command.chat.title: AI Chat
command.chat.keywords: ai, claude, chat, ask, assistant, gpt
command.history.title: AI Chat History
pref.enabled.title: Use AI
pref.enabled.description: Sends the questions you type in an AI chat to Claude through the Claude Code CLI installed on this computer, with your Claude subscription (no API key). Nothing is sent while this is off.
pref.backend.title: Backend
pref.backend.description: The AI tool on this computer that answers. It must be installed and signed in.
pref.model.title: Model
pref.webSearch.title: Allow web search
pref.webSearch.description: Lets Claude search the web and read web pages to answer.
pref.tools.title: Let AI use launcher plugins
pref.tools.description: Lets Claude search and run the launcher's plugins for you, for example to find an app, check a port or install a program. Actions that change something always ask you first. Claude gets no other access to this computer.
pref.retention.title: Keep chats for
pref.retention.description: Older chats are deleted from AI Chat History.
pref.askFallback.title: Offer “Ask AI” when nothing matches
pref.askFallback.description: When the main search finds nothing good, its last entry asks AI about what you typed. Tab always does.
fallback.title: Ask AI: {{.text}}
chat.title: AI Chat
chat.empty:
Ask {{.backend}} anything: type your question and press Enter.

Enter sends, Esc stops an answer and then goes back, Ctrl+K shows more actions.
chat.empty@darwin:
Ask {{.backend}} anything: type your question and press Enter.

Enter sends, Esc stops an answer and then goes back, ⌘K shows more actions.
off.heading: Chat with Claude in the launcher
off.body: golauncher can send your questions to Claude through {{.backend}}, the Claude Code CLI installed on this computer, and your Claude subscription. No API key is needed; the usage counts toward your subscription.
off.privacy: Only what you type in an AI chat is sent, and only after you turn this on. Chats stay on this computer, for 30 days by default (Settings › Plugins › AI). Press Enter to turn it on.
off.pending: Your question will be sent then:
off.placeholder: Press Enter to turn on AI
error.heading: Could not answer.
error.notInstalled: Claude Code is not installed. Install it (see https://claude.com/product/claude-code), sign in by running `claude` in a terminal, then try again.
error.notLoggedIn: Claude Code is not signed in. Run `claude` in a terminal and sign in with your Claude account, then try again.
error.version: This version of Claude Code is too old. Update it with `claude update`, then try again.
error.quota: Your Claude usage limit was reached. Claude Code says:
error.unavailable: The AI backend chosen in Settings › Plugins › AI is not available in this version of golauncher. Choose another one there.
toast.busy: Wait for the answer, or press Esc to stop it
toast.questionCopiedHint: It is too long for a link: paste it into {{.app}}.
pref.translateTo.title: Translate to
pref.translateTo.description: The language that “Translate” turns selected text into. Automatic: the language of golauncher; text already in that language is translated into English.
selection.enable: Use AI to translate and summarize the selected text
selection.enable.keywords: ai, translate, summarize, explain, rewrite, 翻译, 总结
selection.translate.name: Translate
selection.ask.name: Ask AI
selection.explain.keywords: explain, meaning, what is, 解释
selection.rewrite.keywords: rewrite, rephrase, improve, polish, 改写
selection.reply.keywords: reply, replies, respond, answer, 回复
off.selection: Once it is on, you are back at the search, where you choose what AI does with the selected text. Nothing is sent before you choose.
pref.model.codex.title: Model (Codex)
pref.model.codex.description: The model Codex answers with. Default: the default of your Codex CLI version (your own Codex settings are not used).
pref.model.gemini.title: Model (Gemini CLI)
pref.model.gemini.description: The Gemini model that answers when Gemini CLI is the backend.
history.subtitle: {{.time}} · {{.backend}}
chat.backendGone: This chat was started with {{.backend}}, which this version of golauncher does not have. Start a new chat (Ctrl+N) to continue.
chat.backendGone@darwin: This chat was started with {{.backend}}, which this version of golauncher does not have. Start a new chat (⌘N) to continue.
notice.newSession: {{.backend}} could not continue the earlier conversation, so this answer starts a new one: it does not know the messages above.
error.chatUnavailable: This chat was started with {{.backend}}, which is not available in this version of golauncher. Start a new chat (Ctrl+N).
error.chatUnavailable@darwin: This chat was started with {{.backend}}, which is not available in this version of golauncher. Start a new chat (⌘N).
error.notInstalled.codex: Codex is not installed. golauncher runs the native codex.exe: install or update the Codex app, or put codex.exe from https://github.com/openai/codex/releases on PATH, sign in by running `codex login` in a terminal, then try again.
error.notInstalled.codex@darwin: Codex is not installed. golauncher runs the native codex program (never through Node.js): install it with Homebrew (`brew install --cask codex`) or npm (`npm install -g @openai/codex`, which includes it), or put codex from https://github.com/openai/codex/releases on PATH, sign in by running `codex login` in a terminal, then try again.
error.notLoggedIn.codex: Codex is not signed in. Run `codex login` in a terminal and sign in with your ChatGPT account, then try again.
error.version.codex: This version of Codex is too old for golauncher. Update it (the Codex app updates itself; or install the latest codex.exe), then try again.
error.version.codex@darwin: This version of Codex is too old for golauncher. Update it (`brew upgrade --cask codex`, or `npm install -g @openai/codex@latest`), then try again.
error.quota.codex: Your ChatGPT usage limit was reached. Codex says:
error.notInstalled.gemini: Gemini CLI is not installed. Install it (it needs Node.js; see https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli), sign in by running `gemini` in a terminal, then try again.
error.notLoggedIn.gemini: Gemini CLI is not signed in. Run `gemini` in a terminal and sign in with your Google account, then try again.
error.version.gemini: This version of Gemini CLI is too old. Update it (`npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`), then try again.
error.quota.gemini: Your Gemini usage limit was reached. Gemini CLI says:
